✨ LAN-Orangutan | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Network discovery and device management for homelab environments.
✨ Key Features: • Auto-discover devices using nmap • Password protected • Label, group, and add notes to devices • Multi-network support • Tailscale integration
📖 Summary: LAN Orangutan is a self-hosted network discovery tool for homelab users. It allows users to scan their networks, identify devices, and manage them with persistent labeling and notes through a web dashboard or CLI. It also features integration with Tailscale for managing VPN peers.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 SearchPhone | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To perform comprehensive open-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations on a given phone number by aggregating data from various online sources and APIs.
✨ Key Features: • Phone Number Validation • Multiple Search Engines (Google, DuckDuckGo) • Code Repository Search (GitHub)
📖 Summary: SearchPhone is a Python-based OSINT toolkit designed to retrieve information linked to a phone number. It leverages multiple APIs including Google (via SerpAPI), DuckDuckGo, GitHub, Numverify, Reddit, and Hudson Rock to gather data, validate numbers, and check for infostealer compromises. The tool offers parallel processing for speed and generates automatic reports in JSON and PDF formats.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 legend | Jinja
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the generation and deployment of Grafana dashboards for monitoring services and infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Builds dashboards for services with prefilled metrics • Customizable alerts and panels • Automatic setup of basic alerts with priority and service mapping • Uniform dashboard layout • Supports a wide range of components including Airflow, AWS services, Kubernetes, databases, and web servers
📖 Summary: Legend is a tool that automates the creation and publishing of Grafana dashboards for various services and infrastructure components. It pre-fills dashboards with relevant metrics and alerts, reducing manual configuration effort.

✨ legend | Jinja
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the generation and deployment of Grafana dashboards for monitoring various services and infrastructure components.
✨ Key Features: • Build dashboards for services with prefilled metrics • Customizable alerts and panels • Automatic setup of basic alerts with priority and service mapping • Uniform dashboard layout • Support for a wide range of components (Airflow, ALB, Kubernetes, Nginx, etc.)
📖 Summary: Legend is a tool that automates the creation and management of Grafana dashboards for services. It pre-populates dashboards with relevant metrics and alerts, reducing manual effort and ensuring uniformity across monitoring setups.

✨ nginx-ignition | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly graphical interface for configuring and managing the Nginx web server, abstracting away the complexity of manual configuration file editing for developers and enthusiasts.
✨ Key Features: • Virtual host management • Stream proxying (TCP, UDP, Unix sockets) • Versatile routing (proxies, redirects, custom code) • Server configuration (timeouts, log level, etc.)
📖 Summary: nginx-ignition is a Go-based web UI for managing the Nginx web server, designed to simplify configuration for developers and enthusiasts. It offers an intuitive interface for tasks like virtual host management, stream proxying, SSL certificate handling, and security configurations, aiming to provide powerful control without manual file editing.
